ownership_obstacle.observed: Building-holder job detachment reads native mode and selected building; may change ui_workshop_job_cursor at RVA 0x2131b60.
ownership_obstacle.consequence: Do not expose the top-level callback action as an independently semantic routine until this reachable UI dependency is resolved without borrowing or changing native UI state.
ownership_obstacle.remaining: Direct unit calls with pending chain jobs remain prohibited; use the semantic wrapper. Fuller job worker/item fixtures remain required.
ownership_obstacle.dfhack_alternative: DFHack Job::removeJob reconstructs item disconnection then calls job_handler::cancel_job. Supported vtable 0x16d04a8 points to 0xd032a0, a null check and tail jump to 0xa67820. This does not avoid the native UI dependency.
ownership_obstacle.resolution: Unit wrapper removes real BUILDING_HOLDER reciprocal job membership/reference before native job deletion. With those references absent, d022c0 cannot enter the native UI-dependent branch. Remaining deletion and zone-transfer effects stay native.

assignment_dependency_audit.failure_contract: Native action removes prior assignments before appending/allocating the destination reference. Once entered, failure can leave partial effects; report unknown outcome and never auto-replay.
